summary: Proposes the security floor (31 invariants SI-1..31 plus 8 extras FX-1..8, each with the phase it enters and completes, and a note where it needs per-agent accounts or the operator key), the prioritisation of all 82 requirements, a basic version on a disposable estate with 17 fail-closed rows, seven phases PH-0..PH-6 with exit criteria and rollback, 28 hypotheses (H-14 and H-21 can refute the approach), the GP-12 numbers (60 s diagnosis, 14 states and 8 markers), CAND-3 staging in 21 dimensions, and the four items left to this step: account phasing and price, Tier 0 risk classes, the policy record format, the interim controls, plus outage-log reconciliation rules. Nine risk-acceptance requests and 23 one-at-a-time operator questions. Nothing is approved. v0.2: review round 1 fixes applied per docs/reports/T-3352-step3-review/disposition-r1.md (17 rows, see fixes-r1.md); policy record format completed (signing payload, event verbs, epochs, same-level resolution).
